items.h: Jalen Tolbert nabs long touchdown in loss to Colts
items.s: Jalen Tolbert caught both of his targets for 49 yards and a touchdown in the Dolphins' 24-22 loss to the Colts on Sunday. Tolbert was the beneficiary of a trick play drawn up by the Dolphins, where he broke free for a touchdown pass delivered by Malik Washington. He's starting to get a little more involved in the offense, but he's still not worth picking up, given the context of the situation in Miami.

items.h: First TD of season in Week 10 loss
items.s: Tolbert caught both of his targets for 49 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 24-22 loss to the Colts. The wideout was active for just the fifth time in nine games this season and played 11 of 69 offensive snaps. He ran only five routes and caught a 34-yard touchdown from fellow receiver Malik Washington on a trick play early in the second quarter. Tolbert has no fantasy appeal moving forward, as he has just four catches for 79 yards on six targets this season.

Tolbert (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the 49ers. Tolbert will continue to be a healthy scratch for the Dolphins as the team rides with its young talent at wide receiver. Caleb Douglas, Chris Bell and Kevin Coleman will continue to suit up behind the primary option, Malik Washington.

items.h: Jalen Tolbert officially inactive for Week 2
items.s: Dolphins WR Jalen Tolbert is officially inactive for a Week 2 matchup with the 49ers. Tolbert is a healthy inactive for the second straight week to open the season. Fantasy managers should expect Tolbert to need an injury in front of him in order to see a path to playing time.

Miami Dolphins wide receiver Jalen Tolbert tops the inactive list once again as his team prepares to face the San Francisco 49ers in Week 2. Tolbert was a healthy scratch in Week 1 against the Las Vegas Raiders, which opened the door for rookie Caleb Douglas to catch five passes for 94 yards in his NFL debut. Fellow wideouts Malik Washington and Chris Bell should also have a healthy workload in Week 2 with Tolbert on the sidelines. Tolbert signed with the Dolphins in the offseason after four seasons with the Dallas Cowboys and was expected to carve out a role for himself in Miami's evolving receiver room. items.h: Jalen Tolbert's Stock Sinks After Healthy Scratch
items.s: Miami Dolphins wide receiver Jalen Tolbert never got a chance to make an impact in Week 1. He was a healthy scratch against Las Vegas while Caleb Douglas, Chris Bell, Kevin Coleman Jr. and Malik Washington all dressed. That is the bigger concern than an empty box score. Miami entered the season with Douglas, Bell and Washington listed as starters, and the current depth chart still has Bell ahead of Tolbert. Douglas then went out and caught five passes for 94 yards in his NFL debut. Tolbert signed with Miami in March after four seasons in Dallas and had a real chance to carve out a role in a rebuilt receiver room. Instead, the younger group has grabbed the early opportunities. There is time…

Tolbert (coach's decision) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Raiders. With many unproven wide recievers on the roster, Tolbert will take a backseat to the trio of rookies consisting of Caleb Douglas, Chris Bell and Kevin Coleman. The fifth-year veteran will likely only get a shot at suiting up if the youth do not show enough promise over the next couple of games.

items.h: Jalen Tolbert Inactive Ahead of Week 1 Rumble vs. Raiders
items.s: Miami Dolphins wide receiver Jalen Tolbert was a healthy scratch ahead of his team's Week 1 road game against the Raiders in Las Vegas. The fifth-year wideout enters his first season with the Dolphins after spending his first four years with the Dallas Cowboys, amassing 91 receptions for 1,093 yards and 10 touchdowns. Tolbert was expected to be one of new starting quarterback Malik Willis' favorite targets ahead of training camp, but rookie Caleb Douglas surpassed him on the depth chart by the end of preseason play. Malik Washington and Chris Bell are expected to be top targets as the season gets underway, while running back De'Von Achane leads what is expected to be a run-heavy offense in…

items.h: Is Jalen Tolbert Losing Fantasy Relevance in Miami?
items.s: Miami Dolphins wide receiver Jalen Tolbert may struggle to find fantasy relevance in 2026. While he is currently listed as one of three starting wide receivers on Miami's depth chart, it has been rookie Caleb Douglas who has created all of the buzz throughout training camp. Meanwhile, wide receivers Malik Washington and Chris Bell, as well as tight end Greg Dulcich, will also be involved in the passing game, with quarterback Malik Willis now running the offense in Miami. Perhaps most importantly, head coach Jeff Hafley has made it clear that he plans to have a run-heavy offense with a large dose of running back De'Von Achane. Tolbert will see his fair share of targets, but his path to…

Tolbert caught all three of his targets for 27 yards in Friday's 17-12 preseason loss to the Falcons. Tolbert led the team in catches Friday as backup QBs Cam Miller and Mark Gronowski completed a combined 11 passes. The 27-year-old Tolbert is expected to be the top veteran contributor in Miami's young WR room, especially after the Dolphins traded Tutu Atwell to the Rams on Thursday. Third-year pro Malik Washington and rookies Caleb Douglas, Chris Bell and Kevin Coleman represent Tolbert's top competition for regular-season snaps.

items.h: Jalen Tolbert Losing Appeal as a Late-Round Redraft Pick
items.s: Miami Dolphins wide receiver Jalen Tolbert looked like a reasonable late-round flier when camp opened because Miami had no established pecking order at receiver. That case has weakened. Tolbert did not play on Miami's 14-play opening drive in the preseason opener against Washington, with Malik Washington and rookie Caleb Douglas handling most of the first-team work and Jalen Reagor joining them in three-receiver sets. Tolbert later caught one of three targets for 27 yards. Douglas has been one of Miami's camp standouts and is listed with the starters, while fellow third-round rookie Chris Bell (knee) has now shed his non-contact jersey and is expected to play in the preseason finale.…
